metadata.name: Deep-Sea Sediment Core Mineralogical Composition from Event 386-M0095B
metadata.description: A dataset containing mineralogical composition data (percentages of various minerals) for 14 sediment samples collected from a single deep-sea drilling event (386-M0095B) at a depth of approximately 7,697 meters in the western Pacific Ocean. The data includes sample identification, geospatial coordinates, sediment depth, and quantitative mineral abundance values.
metadata.spatial: Point location (single drilling site at 36.89168333°N, 143.4078833°E, -7697m elevation)
